segments.say: Chess rule number three. Black's queen is hanging, and the knight attacks it. Can White take the queen?
segments.caption: Free queen?

segments.say: No! The knight is pinned. If it moves, the rook attacks the king, and you can never leave your own king in check.
Did you know this? Rule number 4 drops tomorrow. Subscribe so you don't miss it.
segments.caption: Rule #4 tomorrow!
